title: Lineb
description: config.ini [Lineb] section (LinebConfig). Fixed-energy LI-NEB through rgsaddle_lineb_solve.

initial_path.description: Multi-frame seed band (neb.con). Every image must start above energy.

energy.description: Tunneling energy E of the equipotential endpoints, eV.

opt_tol.description: Mass-weighted stop on the nudged force.

perp_tol.description: Mass-weighted stop on the perpendicular action gradient.

max_move.description: Step cap; per atom when molecular, else whole-band Euclidean length. 0 leaves the step uncapped.

turning_width.description: Fraction of the highest seed height above E; interiors stay above E+w.

hbar.description: hbar in eV^0.5 amu^0.5 Angstrom. Temperature is hbar/(k_B tau).

quadrature_pairs.description: Simpson pairs per chord for the period quadrature.

beads.description: Harmonic quantum TST replicas. 0 writes the path only (log rate NaN).

molecular.description: false expands atom masses to coordinates. true uses molecule alignment and needs every atom free.
